## Checklist

- [ ] I have read and agree to the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines.
- [ ] All changes go through branches and Pull Requests (no direct pushes to main/develop).
- [ ] I confirm I have the right to submit this content and it does not violate any third-party rights.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords, API keys, customer data, or personal information are included.
- [ ] Test results: <!-- Describe tests run and outcomes -->
- [ ] Does this involve security changes? ☐ Yes ☐ No — Details: _________
- [ ] Does this involve personal information or customer data? ☐ Yes ☐ No — Details: _________
- [ ] Does this add new third-party dependencies? ☐ Yes ☐ No — If yes, name/version/license: _________
- [ ] Does this modify any license file? ☐ Yes ☐ No
- [ ] Does this include AI-generated code? ☐ Yes ☐ No — If yes, was it human-reviewed? ☐ Yes ☐ No
- [ ] IP source confirmation: I confirm the intellectual property source of my contributions is either my original work, properly licensed third-party material, or approved internal work product.
